newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern amends Conrail tender.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern amends Conrail tender.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp said it has amended its cash offer for Conrail Inc to reflect a tender for 8.2 million, or about 9.9 percent, of the railroad's shares.
The 9.9 percent offer expires at midnight EST on Feb 4.
The move by Norfolk Southern follows Friday's meeting of Conrail shareholders in which they rejected a crucial measure in the proposed merger of Conrail and CSX Corp.
Spurned bidder Norfolk Southern last week said it would start a tender for 9.9 percent of Conrail if shareholders defeated the provision.
Norfolk Southern also has said it would start a second tender offer for the remaining Conrail shares at $115 each after it completes the 9.9 percent tender.
Shares of Conrail surged three to 107 in late-morning trade.
